abstract: Covers RFC 6797 HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS): the Strict-Transport-Security header and its max-age and includeSubDomains directives, server processing over HTTPS and HTTP, user agent processing (noting, matching, upgrading and enforcing), max-age=0 removal, staged rollout, and the security considerations. It lists one version line, RFC 6797 (current), and treats the hstspreload.org submission rules (including the non-RFC preload token) and RFC 9460 HTTPS DNS records as dependency sources without version lines. SKILL.md holds the invariants and workflow; references split out versions, the header and server processing, user agent processing, deployment and preloading, and security.

sources.title: HSTS Preload List Submission
